title: CSCI 140 — Computer Science for AP Students
subject: Programming and Languages
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Identify core data structures (lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs) and their access patterns as defined in the course catalog.
Explain the role of objects, classes, and inheritance in achieving cohesion and minimal coupling within software systems.
Apply exception handling and input/output streams to manage runtime errors and user interaction in Python programs.
